name: Can Can Bunny Extra
original_name: きゃんきゃんバニー　エクストラ
source:
Looking at him, he ain't much. But Kenta scores with every girl he meets. Why, Well, he has a love-struck goddess who's decided to help him out. After the celestial sweetie takes a shine to him, she grants him the ability to seduce seven different women to find out which one is his true love, and in the end, it is a big surprise who his actual true love is.

[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2102]ANN[/url]]
